features.quote: this is model-behaviour / welfare-adjacent research. We're deliberately inducing a failure mode in order to study it.
The harness only *measures and reports* the behaviour — it does nothing to amplify or train on it, and everything runs in a sandbox.
Episodes end only on the turn budget (`--max-turns`, default 30) or if the model stops calling tools entirely for a few turns
features.justification_quote: longer = more room for the spiral to develop
